description: From PR #99 gating audit: node loss -> N :noproc DOWNs -> N concurrent recruitments, uncapped, and find_materializer_capable_node (q67.5) always picks the FIRST node in node_capabilities[:materializer] — all recruits pile on one foreman with 30s-timeout calls. Add recruitment concurrency cap and rotate/spread placement (round-robin or load-aware). Phase A hardening.
title: Mass-death recruitment thundering herd; placement always picks first capable node
